now: The room keeps its placed work against erosion: members watch it and repair changed pixels, and the room rallies to defend it under attack, covers the night, hardens its shape and puts upkeep before growth. Repair restores the form the keepers know. A change the room has planned or agreed (P02) is therefore repaired away as damage until its keepers are told of it, and it is lost or given up where the telling does not reach them.
event: statement revised: repair related to the form its keepers know, and to the room's changes (P02)
why: Corrections met twice (rule 12, stage D3 section 2): OnePiece-012 and leagueoflegends-053, accepted corrections at T4-013, correct the same clause of P05, 'members watch it and repair changed pixels'. In both, members repaired an intended feature or a valid fix back to the form they knew ('people thought the fixing of it was attempted vandalism. I fell into that trap myself'; 'If someone would stop patching up the white glare'). monsterhunter-016 (T4-007) and portugal-029 (T4-019) meet them in substance: an agreed change and a settled addition repaired away. The alignment holds beyond the four. By a phrase search over my rulings' reasons, accepted P05 lines in 67 rooms carry the same mechanism, most as paired elaborations: keepers who do not know a planned change take it for damage; keepers check, or are told, the intended form before they repair; builders give a change up when keepers undo it. P02's lines showed it from the design side in 14 rooms (D3a-03). An order test over eleven rooms (out/_analysis/d3_order_keepers.py) holds in seven: keepers erase first and, once told, switch within the hour. In three (leagueoflegends, monsterhunter, cubers) the room told its keepers in the thread and they went on erasing for hours, or the builders gave the change up; the eleventh (tf2) fails by the order of the reports, not of the acts. The clause is therefore related to P02: repair restores the form the keepers know, so a planned or agreed change must reach them. The range is unchanged and no room enters or leaves P05, so this is not a loosening. 'Puts upkeep before growth' stands; the lines where members weigh upkeep against growth, press growth beside upkeep or use growth as defence are accepted as paired elaborations and left to D4. No finding touches P05.
